event.description: Reverse operand columns and reduce ff width to 32 at d16
event.proposal: family: token representation; retained incumbent is 6080 parameters at 100.0000%, a +1.00 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: none; same-family failed result: none; prior attempts in this family: 0. The latest different-family result, attempt-0001, was a 3456-parameter shared-block optimization failure at 75.95% validation after 30000 steps. Hypothesis: reversing both padded operands aligns least-significant columns with the reversed answer, reducing the positional lookup burden; the paired ff48-to-ff32 compression tests whether that alignment can support an eligible 5056-parameter model. This is more informative than the nearest untested binary-token encoding because it preserves the vocabulary and directly tests column alignment while making only one capacity reduction. The candidate uses the same d16, h2, L2 attention stack, ff32, 15000 training steps, and final-checkpoint fallback; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly fewer than 6080 parameters.
